serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-a2a-auditor
serverInfo.description: MCP server that scans Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol implementation code for anti-patterns found in the reference SDKs and sample agents: unauthenticated push-notification webhook fetches (SSRF), Agent Cards with no authentication requirement, and credentials embedded in publicly-served Agent Card metadata

tools.name: scan_text
tools.description: Scan A2A protocol implementation code for anti-patterns: unauthenticated webhook fetches (SSRF), Agent Cards with no authentication requirement, and credentials embedded in Agent Card metadata.

label.description: Optional label shown in findings (e.g. filename)

tools.name: scan_file
tools.description: Scan a single file for A2A (Agent2Agent) protocol anti-patterns

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file to scan

tools.name: scan_directory
tools.description: Recursively scan a directory of A2A agent source for protocol anti-patterns

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the directory to scan

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to scan (default: 5000)

include.description: Only scan files whose path contains one of these strings

exclude.description: Skip files/dirs whose path contains one of these strings

tools.name: list_patterns
tools.description: List every A2A (Agent2Agent) protocol pattern this auditor detects, grouped by category
